title: Practice: Future: I will write, I'm going to write

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **стать → станешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**сделать → сделаем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я не ___ (дать, pf., fut. 1st sg.) ей вмешаться.
exercises.why: **дать → дам** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**спросить → Спросим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: We will ask at a travel agency.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (взять, pf., fut. 2nd sg.) меня туда?
exercises.why: **взять → возьмешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (пойти, pf., fut. 1st sg.) в воскресенье.
exercises.why: **пойти → пойду** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (выйти, pf., fut. 1st sg.) за тебя замуж.
exercises.why: **выйти → выйду** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я больше его не ___ (увидеть, pf., fut. 1st sg.).
exercises.why: **увидеть → увижу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: I will not see him any more.

exercises.q: Том не ___ (прийти, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) вовремя.
exercises.why: **прийти → придёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Сейчас ты ___ (начать, pf., fut. 2nd sg.) согреваться.
exercises.why: **начать → начнёшь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: Now you will start to warm up.

exercises.q: Подмены никто не ___ (заметить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **заметить → заметит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
exercises.prompt: No one will notice the substitution.

exercises.q: У меня ___ (остаться, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) шрам?
exercises.why: **остаться → останется** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я не ___ (быть, impf., fut. 1st sg.) спать, Гортензио, пока не увижу её.
exercises.prompt: I will not sleep, Hortensio, till I see her.
exercises.why: **быть → буду** — future of быть: 1st person singular.

exercises.q: ___ (быть, impf., fut. 3rd pl.) использованы текущие настройки сессии.
exercises.prompt: The current session settings will be used.
exercises.why: **быть → Будут** — future of быть: 3rd person plural.

exercises.q: Шестидесятичетырёхразрядное программное обеспечение не ___ (быть, impf., fut. 3rd sg.) работать на тридцатидвухразрядной архитектуре.
exercises.prompt: Sixty-four-bit software will not run on 32-bit architecture.
exercises.why: **быть → будет** — future of быть: 3rd person singular.
